title: Classifier calibration error to Fisher-information loss
statement: The audited CLASSIFIER-CALIBRATION-SCORE-LIPSCHITZ bridge supplies an upper score-error budget from excess Brier error. Reliability and resolution gap split that posterior error; a reverse score-error bound needs an injective chart and explicit constants. Calibration error does not certify retention distortion, and AUC does not determine proxy reporting error. Remaining: certify the resolution gap without truth scores (OP19), sharper constants, and D_s efficiency.
